title: Hammond Museum

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The Hammond Museum offers a quiet retreat that allows business people to step away from hectic daily life to both focus their attention and expand their perspectives. Two meeting rooms are available inside the museum for 10 and 25 people, respectively. Further, the patio, under a large all-weather tent, is available for gatherings up to 150 people for large meetings or a post-meeting celebration. The Japanese Stroll Garden provides a unique and serene bonus to your day’s program.​ Whether you are planning an informal gathering or a catered event, the Hammond Museum and Japanese Stroll Garden offers a unique and serene setting for your special event. services.name: Ceramic Tea Bowl
services.desc: Dr. Eisenstadt is the district arts coordinator for Scarsdale Schools, NY. She also teaches Japanese Art History at Parsons School of Design, NY. This lesson was created in November of 2020 for the Hammond Museum and Japanese Stroll Garden with generous funding from Japan Foundation Center for Global Partnership. This lesson is connected to the Japanese Tea Ceremony and the utensils used during the ceremony, in particular the tea bowl. The purpose of this lesson is to make a tea bowl focusing on the aesthetics found in the philosophy of wabi-sabi.
